sync_grad_params: sync gradients across distributed workers by calling sync_grad on model parameters after backward
broadcast_tensors_to_workers: broadcast model tensors from a source worker to all other workers in a distributed setup
sync_buffers_across_workers: sync or average buffer data across all distributed workers using sync_buffer
average_metrics_across_workers: average a dictionary of metrics across all distributed workers using average_metrics
all_reduce_tensor: perform an all_reduce operation on a tensor across all distributed workers with a specified reduce op
